MARTINA BALAGOVI ´C AND STEF AN KOLB
Abstract. Let g be a symmetrizable Kac-Moody algebra and let Uq(g) de-
note the corresponding quantized enveloping algebra. In th e present paper
we show that quantum symmetric pair coideal subalgebras Bc,s of Uq(g) have
a universal K-matrix if g is of ﬁnite type. By a universal K-matrix for Bc,s
we mean an element in a completion of Uq(g) which commutes with Bc,s and
provides solutions of the reﬂection equation in all integra ble Uq(g)-modules in
category O. The con

blocks.content:

symmetric pairs by Noumi, Sugitani, and Dijkhuizen [Nou96], [NS95], [NDS 97],

rise to universal K-matrices. The fact that quantum symmetric pa irs Bc,s are
coideal subalgebras of Uq(g) moreover suggests to base the concept of a universal
K-matrix on a coideal subalgebra of a braided (or quasitriangular) H opf algebra.

∆(B) ⊂B ⊗Uq(g).
